ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: A woman suffering from a single-gene dominant hereditary disease (her father and husband have normal phenotypes) wants to give birth to a healthy child. The doctor recommends genetic analysis of polar bodies to screen out egg cells that do not contain the pathogenic gene, and using in vitro fertilization technology to assist reproduction of offspring. The schematic diagram of the technical process is shown in the figure. Question: In the capacitation solution, which period among ①②③ is the period when sperm enters the egg?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A woman suffering from a single-gene dominant hereditary disease (her father and husband have normal phenotypes) wants to give birth to a healthy child. The doctor recommends genetic analysis of polar bodies to screen out egg cells that do not contain the pathogenic gene, and using in vitro fertilization technology to assist reproduction of offspring. The schematic diagram of the technical process is shown in the figure. Question: In the capacitation solution, which period among ①②③ is the period when sperm enters the egg?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the process goes from “affected woman” to “primary oocyte”; the primary oocyte forms “polar body 1” and “secondary oocyte” through the step labeled ①; the secondary oocyte forms “polar body 2” and “egg cell” through the step labeled ②; afterward the egg cell is connected to the “fertilized egg” on the right, with ③ marked nearby, followed by “early embryo” and “implantation into uterus.” Then reason: in the process of in vitro fertilization, when the sperm enters the egg, the egg cell is actually at the secondary oocyte stage. After the sperm enters, it stimulates the secondary oocyte to complete the second meiotic division, extrude the second polar body, form the egg cell, and further form the fertilized egg. The stage in the figure where the “secondary oocyte forms polar body 2 and egg cell” corresponds to ②, so the period when sperm enters the egg is ②.
